notes: copies = number of physical cards in the print sheets, verified to match the rulebook component list.
rulesText is authoritative card text; structured fields are convenience data for the engine.

gladiators.name: Vulgaris Gladiator
gladiators.flavor: The everyman of the arena, steady and dependable.

gladiators.name: Velox Gladiator
gladiators.flavor: Fleet of foot, striking before the eye can follow.
gladiators.rulesText: Speed: At the start of the Attack Phase, draw 2 Attack cards, choose 1 to play, discard the other.

gladiators.name: Bestia Gladiator
gladiators.flavor: A mountain of fury that knows no fear.

gladiators.name: Retiarius Gladiator
gladiators.flavor: Net and trident, the fisherman of the sands.
gladiators.rulesText: Begins with a Rete already equipped (cannot unequip or sell). It still occupies 1 weapon slot.

gladiators.name: Invictus Gladiator
gladiators.flavor: The undefeated champion, blessed by the gods.
gladiators.rulesText: May only equip body armor. May not equip shields, helmets, or limb guards.

gladiators.name: Debilis Gladiator
gladiators.flavor: Battered and bloodied, but not yet finished.

weapons.name: Pugio (Dagger)
weapons.flavor: A legionary's last resort — swift and deadly up close.
weapons.rulesText: If the defending Gladiator has fewer than 30 VITA, double this weapon's Attack before subtracting armor.

weapons.name: Gladius (Short Sword)
weapons.flavor: The blade that conquered the known world.
weapons.rulesText: Cannot be paired with a Tridens (Trident).

weapons.name: Pilum (Spear)
weapons.flavor: Punches through shield and armor alike.
weapons.rulesText: Ignores 5 points of the defender's armor.

weapons.name: Sica (Curved Blade)
weapons.flavor: The Thracian's blade, made to hook past a shield.
weapons.rulesText: Ignores 20 points of the defender's armor.

weapons.name: Tridens (Trident)
weapons.flavor: The fisherman's spear, turned to blood sport.
weapons.rulesText: Cannot be paired with a Gladius (Short Sword). Main hand only.

weapons.name: Spatha (Long Sword)
weapons.flavor: A cavalry blade of fearsome reach.

weapons.name: Flagrum (Whip)
weapons.flavor: A cruel lash that strips weapons from the grip.
weapons.rulesText: On a hit, target must discard one card of their choice from their hand.

weapons.name: Rete (Net)
weapons.rulesText: Reduces target's dodge range by 1 (minimum 1). One-handed. Maximum 1 per Gladiator.

weapons.name: Leo (Lion)
weapons.flavor: An unleashed beast, as likely to maul as obey.
weapons.rulesText: Two-handed weapon. Damage 10–60. Ignores armor. Reduces dodge by 1 (minimum 1).

weapons.name: Ursus (Bear)
weapons.flavor: A towering brute of claw and muscle.
weapons.rulesText: One-handed. Damage 8–48. Reduces auto-hit damage you take this round by 10.

weapons.name: Canis (War Dog)
weapons.flavor: A trained killer that slips past armor.

armor.name: Subarmalis (Padded Vest)
armor.flavor: Humble quilted padding, better than bare skin.

armor.name: Parma (Round Shield)
armor.flavor: A light round shield favoured by skirmishers.

armor.name: Ocreae (Greaves)
armor.flavor: Bronze guards for the front-line shins.

armor.name: Galea (Visored Helmet)
armor.flavor: A crested, visored helm that defies the net.
armor.rulesText: Negates the Rete's dodge reduction effect.

armor.name: Scutum (Large Shield)
armor.flavor: The great curved shield of the legions.

armor.name: Lorica Squamata (Scale Armor)
armor.flavor: Overlapping scales that turn aside a blow.
armor.rulesText: Body armor. Reduces auto-hit damage by 10.

armor.name: Lorica Segmentata (Plate Armor)
armor.flavor: Banded iron plate, the finest coin can buy.
armor.rulesText: Body armor. Reduces auto-hit damage by 20. Cannot be worn with other body armor.

specials.name: Aqua Vitae (Water of Life)
specials.flavor: A sacred draught that restores the flesh.
specials.rulesText: Restore 30 VITA. May be used at any time, including during the Attack Phase after taking damage. Cannot use if your VITA goes below 0.

specials.name: Harena (Sand)
specials.flavor: A fistful of arena dust, flung to blind.
specials.rulesText: Throw at an opponent to reduce their dodge range by 1 for the Attack Phase (minimum 1). Must be declared after drawing an attack card.

specials.name: Furor (Rage)
specials.flavor: The battle-fury that guides a killing blow.
specials.rulesText: Add 1 to your attack roll this phase (a roll of 5 becomes 6, triggering an auto-hit). Must be declared after drawing an attack card.

specials.name: Medicus Scroll (Physician's Scroll)
specials.rulesText: Restore 20 VITA to your Gladiator. May be used at any time, including during the Attack Phase after taking damage. Cannot use if VITA goes below 0.

specials.name: Interceptio (Sabotage)
specials.flavor: A bribe, a theft — the games are never fair.
specials.rulesText: Can only be used during the Equip Phase. Remove one equipped one-handed weapon or armor from any opponent. They receive half its sell value (rounded up to the nearest 5).

specials.name: Fortuna (Fortune)
specials.flavor: The goddess of luck smiles upon you.
specials.rulesText: Draw 2 equipment cards, keep 1, then discard the other.

legendaries.name: Fulgur Iovis (Lightning of Jupiter)
legendaries.flavor: The thunderbolt of the king of gods.
legendaries.rulesText: Attacks two players simultaneously. Roll for attack once. Each opponent dodges separately. Deals 60 damage minus armor to each hit. Auto-hit: deal 60 damage to both opponents, ignores armor.

legendaries.name: Lorica Hephaesti (Armor of Hephaestus)
legendaries.flavor: Forged in divine fire to turn aside death.
legendaries.rulesText: 45 defense. Once per game, use it to negate one hit entirely (take 0 damage).

legendaries.name: Ensis Martis (Blade of Mars)
legendaries.flavor: The war god's sword thirsts for blood.
legendaries.rulesText: On a successful hit, draw and immediately play an extra attack card.

legendaries.name: Talaria Mercurii (Sandals of Mercury)
legendaries.flavor: Winged sandals of the messenger god.
legendaries.rulesText: Adds 2 to your dodge range. Maximum total dodge range is 4.

legendaries.name: Hasta Achillis (Spear of Achilles)
legendaries.flavor: The hero's spear, guided by fate.
legendaries.rulesText: Auto-hits on a roll of 5 or 6 (not just 6).

legendaries.name: Cerberus (Hound of Hades)
legendaries.flavor: The three-headed hound of the underworld.
legendaries.rulesText: Damage 8–48. Ignores armor. Reduces dodge by 1 (minimum 1).

legendaryRules.marketBehavior: If flipped into the Market, discard it and redraw (same as specials).

attackCards.name: Attack Left
attackCards.rulesText: Attack the player to your left.

attackCards.name: Attack Right
attackCards.rulesText: Attack the player to your right.

attackCards.name: Attack Your Choice
attackCards.rulesText: Attack a player of your choice.

hadesCards.usage: Play on your turn while eliminated. One use — discard.

cards: You went on a date with Persephone. Distracted, you do nothing this turn.
Stuck feeding Cerberus — all three heads. No meddling this turn.
Charon's ferry is running late. You wait on the riverbank.
Lost in the Fields of Asphodel. You wander aimlessly this turn.
Hades has you organizing the underworld's scrolls. Busywork.
You drank from the river Lethe and forgot what you meant to do.
The shades are throwing a feast. You attend instead of scheming.
You argue with the ferryman over the toll. The turn slips away.
Elysium's gates were open for a tour. You couldn't resist.
You tried to bribe a Fury. It did not go well. Nothing happens.
You lost a sandal in the Styx and spent the turn fishing for it.
Hades put you on judgment duty. Paperwork for the damned.
Mesmerized by the three-headed dog, you stare the turn away.
You wait in the long queue at the gates of Tartarus.
You linger to watch your own funeral games. Bittersweet.

cards.text: The dead riot in the stands! All living gladiators' dodge −1 this round (min 1).
A cold wind blows from Hades. All living gladiators take 5 damage.
The restless crowd jeers. Every living gladiator discards 1 card.
Ghostly hands rattle the racks. All attack rolls −1 this round.
The underworld stirs. All living gladiators' dodge −1 this round (min 1).
Shrieking shades unnerve the arena. All attack rolls −1 this round.
A chill grips the sand. The lowest-HP living gladiator takes 5 damage.
Straps rot in the underworld air. All living gladiators' armor −10 this round.

whisperFromBelow.effect: one gladiator of the dead player's choice

cards.text: You whisper a curse. Chosen gladiator's dodge −1 this round (min 1).
A sudden cramp! Chosen gladiator drops a weapon — it is inactive this round.
Their armor comes untied. Chosen gladiator's armor −10 this round.
You spook their nerve. Chosen gladiator's next attack roll −1 this round.
A shade trips them. Chosen gladiator's attack hits a RANDOM player this round.
The dead clutch their arm. Chosen gladiator may not play a Special this round.
A ghostly grip drags at them. Chosen gladiator's dodge −1 this round (min 1).
